_about: House colours. facade: [hex, weight, family, name]. Houses that touch never share a colour, and avoid sharing a family where they can. v0.17: chosen so the reference photos (Riomaggiore harbour, the shuttered facades), the paint-overs (art-target-v2) and the greyscale plaster texture agree: more pinks, creams and a few cool houses, fewer oranges, every colour a little less saturated (limewash paint is chalky). With v0.16's light a wall in full sun shows about the colour written here. History: v0.13 stronger and oranger (towards art target 05); v0.12 paler. See PROGRESS.md (Stage 2) for the reasoning.
_shutter: Shutters: the deep bottle green of Ligurian persiane (dark in shade, emerald only where the sun hits the slats), a few lighter or sun-faded, the odd bare brown or slate-blue pair. Hue between the photos' yellower green and the paint-overs' teal. v0.13-v0.16 were lighter and brighter (#2f7656 ... #4a8a63) and read as flat poster green.
